A3.interpretation: Both routes keep the user's messages verbatim in Codex 0.163.0 (tag rust-v0.163.0; local: codex-rs/core/src/compact.rs 393-396, user messages up to 20,000 tokens, newest first, plus the summary; remote: codex-rs/core/src/compact_remote_v2.rs, user messages within 64,000 tokens plus the encrypted item, assistant messages dropped). The local read of the route prediction is the summary alone, so the deployed vs local contrast compares retained user messages plus the server's summariser, with 3 compactions per conversation, against a local-prompt summary alone, with 1 compaction: a contrast of summariser, retention and number of compactions together, not a test of retention (A2 is the retention test).
